svg.title: Work units per accepted change
svg.desc: Ten practice tickets used 72 units of agent work. The team accepted six changes. An open ticket still uses some of the budget. Count the work. Include all 72 units, including the work on tickets that are still open or ended without a fix. Count the results. Six changes passed review. The two open tickets and two closed without a fix add no accepted change. Divide. 72 units divided by 6 accepted changes is 12 units each. If no change passed, report the units spent on their own.
